thread:
maria: Quick draft of the internal release notes for the runtime + search-model deploy tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Can people confirm bullets and rollback criteria? Plan: canary -> 10% EU, pin to 1.12.3, monitor token-level latency.
kevin: LGTM. Add quiet window note (no big blasts) and the deploy window in RN. Also tag @june for rollback.
alex: Add explicit thresholds: error-rate > 1% OR p50 latency regression > 20% for 5m => rollback. Also include the deploybot command we will run:
```
/deploy start --pin=1.12.3 --canary=10% --region=eu --notify=eng-releases
```
june: I'll be on standby during the window. If rollback needed, say "rollback now" in this thread and I’ll execute.
deploy-bot: ack: will run canary when command received. Will post progress updates and final status. Finalize exact command at T-2h to lock request.
opsbot: Heads-up: set incident watch on these metrics (search.p50, search.error_rate). I'll create a short dashboard and alert rule.
sara: Product check: no customer-facing change. Add a single line in the RN: "No user-visible changes; backend model swap for ranking." Keep message minimal.
maria: Thanks — here's my final internal RN snippet to paste into the blast:
"Planned deploy (1.12.3) of the search ranking model on 03:00 UTC. Canary 10% in EU. We will monitor latency and error rate. Rollback criteria: >1% errors or p50 latency >20% regression sustained for 5 minutes. Standby: @june. No user-facing changes expected."
kevin: Ready. We'll send internal blast at T-1h and lock pin at T-30m. @deploy-bot confirm once you receive the command.
june: :thumbsup:
maria: final pin command I'll run at T-10m:
`/deploy start --pin=1.12.3 --canary=10% --regions=eu --announce-channel=eng-releases`
deploy-bot: confirmed: will post status here when started and on each milestone (canary-start, canary-pass, promoted, rollback).
kevin: thanks all—I'll queue the blast draft in #eng-releases for quick signoff. If anything changes, update this thread.
